title: Centre plans MMDR Act overhaul, to draft comprehensive new mining law
description:
The government is considering overhauling the Mines and Minerals (Development and Regulation) Act, 1957, into a comprehensive new mining law, a move aimed to incorporate ease of living and ease of doing business reforms, sources said.
The mines ministry administers the Mines and Minerals (Development and Regulation) Act, 1957 (MMDR Act)
The Act has been amended from time-to-time to keep pace with the evolving requirements of the mining and minerals sector, sources said.
In recent years, the Centre has made efforts to review the nation's regulatory landscape to incorporate ease of living and ease of doing business reforms across all sectors.
Considering that the mining and mineral sector is important for the economy, future technological progress, fulfilling the strategic needs of the country, and achieving the vision of Viksit Bharat by 2047, the MMDR Act, 1957, is proposed to be overhauled into a comprehensive and streamlined new mining law, sources said.
